items.title: Add PostgreSQL Flexible Server as a JIT whitelist targetType
items.description: New targetType token 'postgresqlFlexibleServer' (camelCase, like sqlServer). ARM provider Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL/flexibleServers; Resource Graph type lowercase 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers'. Firewall child path .../flexibleServers/{name}/firewallRules/{ruleName}, api-version 2024-08-01, body {properties:{startIpAddress,endIpAddress}} (same as SQL). DECISIONS: (1) create AND delete are async 202+Azure-AsyncOperation -> POLL to completion (honor Retry-After, bounded timeout); a failed/timed-out expiry delete must NOT delete the table row (retries next cycle) and must audit. (2) PRE-FLIGHT REJECT private-access/VNet-integrated servers (they have no firewall rules) with a clear denial. Stored rule shape unchanged. Touchpoints: JITTargets.psm1 (new Add/Remove-JITPostgresFirewallRule + LRO poll helper + exports); Request-JITAccess run.ps1 (header, supportedTypes L133, dispatch L330-334); Revoke run.ps1 switch; Remove-ExpiredRules run.ps1 (supportedTypes L45, switch); Manager role in 3 synced places (JIT-AzAccess-Manager.json, Grant-JITPermissions.ps1, Test-JITAccess.ps1) add flexibleServers read + firewallRules read/write/delete + descriptions; plugin ResourceDiscovery.cs KQL+map, ArmVerifier.cs const+switch+VerifyPostgresRuleAsync, JitAzAccessPlugin.cs TargetTypeLabel, JitTarget.cs doc; README L184; new dispatch test in Remove-ExpiredRules.Tests.ps1.

items.title: Add 12 more JIT whitelist asset types + plugin asset-type selector
items.description: Add 12 asset types (decision: 'everything viable'): child firewallRules -> mysqlFlexibleServer (Microsoft.DBforMySQL/flexibleServers), redis (Microsoft.Cache/Redis, SYNC, body uses startIP/endIP), synapse (Microsoft.Synapse/workspaces). Array-on-resource (read-modify-write parent, ETag/If-Match + 412 retry) -> cosmosDb (DocumentDB/databaseAccounts ipRules{ipAddressOrRange}, LRO slow), containerRegistry (ContainerRegistry/registries networkRuleSet.ipRules, Premium-only, defaultAction Deny), aiSearch (Search/searchServices networkRuleSet.ipRules{value}), cognitiveServices (CognitiveServices/accounts networkAcls.ipRules{value}, covers OpenAI, defaultAction Deny), kusto (Kusto/clusters allowedIpRangeList bare string[]), iotHub (Devices/IotHubs networkRuleSets.ipRules{filterName,action,ipMask}, whole-resource PUT), signalR (SignalRService/signalR networkACLs.ipRules, preserve sibling ACLs). Child-singleton array (PUT networkRuleSets/default) -> eventHub (EventHub/namespaces, Std/Premium), serviceBus (ServiceBus/namespaces, Std/Premium). EXCLUDED: App Service (priority-ordered site-config model, separate effort), App Configuration (no ipRules - unsupported). Cross-cutting: one canonical type table drives ResourceDiscovery KQL + MapToTarget + config option list; shared ETag read-modify-write helper for array types; Manager role RBAC actions added in Grant/Test scripts. PLUGIN config: Boolean checkbox per asset type + an 'All' checkbox (host renders Boolean/Text/Number only; NO Select/WPF), select-all logic in SetValue, gating ResourceDiscovery ('All'/unset = no filter). Verify per-type api-version/RBAC/LRO against MS Learn during impl (researcher flagged gaps).

items.title: JIT batch: App Service + AKS targets, mandatory justification, single notification, idempotent add, remove-cleanup, audit table
items.description: SIX items. (1) NEW TARGETS: appService (Microsoft.Web/sites ipSecurityRestrictions on config/web, PATCH sync, NSG-style priority, MAIN+SCM per decision; GUARD: only add if site already restricted - never lock down an open site; RBAC Microsoft.Web/sites/config/{read,write}; api 2024-04-01) and aks (Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters apiServerAccessProfile.authorizedIPRanges string[], PUT full-body LRO; REJECT private clusters; SAFETY: NEVER write empty array on remove = would open API server to internet; RBAC managedClusters/{read,write}; api 2025-05-01). (2) JUSTIFICATION REQUIRED by default for ALL requests; opt-out only if app-reg tag 'JustificationRequired:false' present. Server-authoritative in Request-JITAccess (read app-reg tags via MI Graph token Get-ManagedIdentityToken + GET /applications/{AZURETRAY_APP_REGISTRATION_OBJECT_ID}?=tags; FAIL-SAFE to required if unreadable); 400 if missing+required. Plugin: read marker from already-fetched JitUrlDiscovery tags, invert prompt gate, keep empty-reject, add 400 branch. (3) SINGLE notification: plugin shows only ONE success toast on CONFIRMED - delete premature toast JitAzAccessPlugin.cs:1211-1217; make VerifyAndNotifyAsync own all 5 VerificationResult outcomes (green only on Confirmed; Skipped/Timeout/Error/NotFound get one non-green toast); handle _verifier null. (4) ALREADY-WHITELISTED: before add, detect caller IP already present -> no duplicate; success. Manage-if-ours: if existing JITRules row tracks this IP+resource refresh expiry; if external (no row) leave untouched + no removal scheduled. (5) REMOVE CLEANUP: if IP/rule not found on remove (manual deletion), treat as success and STILL delete the JITRules table row (all handlers + Revoke + Remove-ExpiredRules). (6) AUDIT TABLE 'JITRulesAudit' (no hyphen - Azure table constraint), FULL LIFECYCLE: append a row on grant AND on remove/expire with action/event + timestamp columns.

comments.author: developer
comments.text: ALL 6 items implemented (function app + plugin), builds/parses clean, test.ps1 baseline 97/76/21 (no regressions). Item1: appService (main+SCM, add-only-if-restricted) + aks (PUT/LRO, reject private, never write empty array) handlers + wiring + role + JSON + plugin catalog. Item2: server justification required unless app-reg tag 'JustificationRequired:false' (fail-safe required; cached; 400+audit) + plugin UX (marker read, gate invert, 400 branch). Item3: single toast (green only on Confirmed; VerifyAndNotifyAsync owns all 5 outcomes). Item4: Add Status Created/AlreadyPresent/SkippedOpen; per-mechanism dup detection (Test-JITFirewallRuleCoversIp for child, array membership, appService by IP, NSG exact-match best-effort); Request branches manage-if-ours (Extend via new Update-JITTableRow MERGE) / AlreadyExternal / SkippedOpen. Item5: Remove Status Removed/NotFound/Refused; Removed|NotFound delete row+audit; AKS Refused keeps row+RemoveFailed. Item6: JITRulesAudit full lifecycle (Grant/Extend/AlreadyExternal/SkippedOpen/Revoke/Expire/RemoveFailed), best-effort. Testcase pass adding coverage now.
